title: Big Laurel

Soon after, Captain Allston arrives at the Howe family's summer bungalow following a car accident, bringing with him the worldview and restlessness of a man recently returned from war. The narrative shifts between the perspectives of Bud, Roxie, and Allston, revealing Bud's escalating obsession, Roxie's growing infatuation with her "fairy tale prince," and the burgeoning connection between Allston and Miss Wilmer Howe. Tensions rise when Bud, driven by jealousy and frustration, plots against Allston, but refrains from violence at the last moment upon witnessing a telling scene between Allston and Wilmer.
